methodology.rationale: TOLOM is a live product approaching beta — not greenfield. The existing 14-module codebase needs incremental hardening, not a rewrite. Evolutionary architecture lets you refactor report-service.ts (90KB), backfill tests, and ship Phase 1 features without freezing development. TDD as a sub-methodology for new service-layer work and bug fixes.

alternativeConsidered.name: TDD (primary)
alternativeConsidered.rejected: TDD-first works for greenfield. Applying it wholesale to 40 existing untested services would halt feature delivery. Better as targeted sub-methodology for new code and critical-path bugs.

phases.name: Harden
phases.focus: Backfill tests on critical-path services (work-orders, invoices, inventory), split report-service.ts, fix type check CI gate

phases.name: Polish
phases.focus: UI/UX flow fixes per PLAN.md Rounds A-D, tablet touch targets, i18n automation

phases.name: Ship Beta
phases.focus: E2E coverage for core workflow chain, CI hardening, deploy preview validation

gsd.whenToUse: Before any refactoring sprint. Run on report-service.ts to identify extractable modules, and on the full services/ directory to map test coverage gaps.
After every refactoring step (splitting report-service.ts, adding RLS policies, type regeneration). Produces a verification artifact.
Weekly health check: test coverage delta, migration count, type sync status, CI pass rate, bundle size drift.
For PLAN.md Round B (work order flow redesign). The 6-step wizard refactor needs iterative feedback loops, not a single-pass implementation.
For isolated, well-scoped tasks: adding a single i18n key pair, updating one service, fixing one type error.

methodologies.whenToUse: For all NEW service-layer code (new API routes, new query hooks, new service methods) and for bug fixes in critical-path services (invoices, work orders, payments). Write test first for any financial logic.
methodologies.scope: New code only — do not retrofit TDD on untouched existing services during feature work

methodologies.whenToUse: End of each development phase (Harden/Polish/Ship). Assess: test coverage %, CI reliability, bundle size, accessibility score, i18n parity.

specializations.whenToUse: Primary specialization. Covers the full stack: App Router pages, API routes, React Query hooks, Supabase services, middleware. Use as the default development context.

specializations.whenToUse: For component-level work: shadcn additions, component refactoring, form patterns. Narrower scope than nextjs-fullstack-app.

automatedRemediations.description: Script that diffs keys between mn.json and en.json, reports missing keys in either file. Run in CI.
